e.title: GIP125 Auto Loss Cost (SOA)
e.summary: SOA 官方研究《Auto Loss Trends & COVID》配套代码：车险损失成本趋势分析
e.body: GIP125 是 SOA 研究学会《Auto Loss Trends and COVID》研究报告（soa.org/resources/research-reports/2022/auto-loss-trends-covid）的公开配套代码：车险损失成本趋势分析（含 COVID 冲击的损失趋势建模）。对车险定价研究：官方报告+可复现代码的组合，理解损失成本趋势与外部冲击（疫情）对定价的影响。与 [[claim-frequency]]（DAV 车险定价）、[[machine-learning-pricing]]、[[actuarial-pricing]] 互补。
e.verified_note: raw README 核实：SOA Research Institute 官方项目 GIP125，2022 车险损失趋势（COVID）研究报告配套代码
e.summary_en: Companion code of the SOA research report 'Auto Loss Trends and COVID': auto loss-cost trend analysis
e.summary_hk: SOA 官方研究《Auto Loss Trends & COVID》配套代碼：車險損失成本趨勢分析
e.body_en: GIP125 is the public companion code of the SOA Research Institute's report 'Auto Loss Trends and COVID' (soa.org/resources/research-reports/2022/auto-loss-trends-covid): auto loss-cost trend analysis, including modelling loss trends under the COVID shock. For motor-pricing research: an official report plus reproducible code — understand how loss-cost trends and external shocks (pandemic) affect pricing. Complements [[claim-frequency]] (DAV motor pricing), [[machine-learning-pricing]] and [[actuarial-pricing]].
e.body_hk: GIP125 是 SOA 研究學會《Auto Loss Trends and COVID》研究報告（soa.org/resources/research-reports/2022/auto-loss-trends-covid）的公開配套代碼：車險損失成本趨勢分析（含 COVID 衝擊的損失趨勢建模）。對車險定價研究：官方報告+可複現代碼的組合，理解損失成本趨勢與外部衝擊（疫情）對定價的影響。與 [[claim-frequency]]（DAV 車險定價）、[[machine-learning-pricing]]、[[actuarial-pricing]] 互補。
